DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL).

The combination of severe pancytopenia, extremely elevated white blood cells, and the presence of Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped inclusions) on the peripheral smear is pathognomonic for this condition. I am requesting a bone marrow aspiration and cytogenetic testing for the t(15;17) translocation to confirm the diagnosis immediately.
